in_hebrew.name: Bahner
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bringer of Good News
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bahner הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'baino', meaning 'to go', this name was given to those who spread the good news of Christianity. The name Bahner can be traced back to the early Christian era, particularly among the missionaries who traveled far and wide to spread the teachings of Jesus Christ.
